findings.title: Stale-file pruning lost its containment guard
findings.description: `finish()` now deletes stale files with `path.join(this.targetRoot, rel)`, then `isFile` (which follows symlinks), then `fs.rmSync`. The only check is that the CRC and size match a manifest line. The deleted `worktreePropagation.ts` `pruneStaleFiles` rejected lexically escaping paths (`escapesLexically`), checked `realpath` containment of the parent directory, and skipped non-regular files. A manifest line such as `<crc> <size> ../../x` with a matching CRC deletes a file outside the checkout, and this path now runs for the root install as well as worktrees. The deleted `worktreePrune.test.ts` covered `..` paths and symlinked escapes, and no replacement test exists under `tests/ideInstall/`. Restore the containment and non-regular checks in `finish()` and add back the `..` and symlink tests.

findings.title: Dry run can write through absolute symlinks into real locations
findings.description: `copyInstallPaths` uses `fs.cpSync` with `verbatimSymlinks: true`. Symlink entries are copied as links, and absolute targets stay absolute. If `.claude/rules` is a symlink to `/Users/x/shared/rules`, the install run in the sandbox writes and prunes through that link into the real directory. `reportChanges` uses `lstat`, so the link is invisible in the report. That breaks the dry-run contract ("nothing was written"). Relative links resolve inside the sandbox's temp tree, so only absolute links are affected. Fix by refusing to write through symlinks in the sandbox, or by materializing them, and add a test with an absolute symlinked directory.

findings.title: Overlapping `rules.exclude` patterns produce a false "matched no rule files" warning
findings.description: `isExcluded` uses `find()` and records only the first matching pattern in `matched`. When two patterns both match a file, the second is never marked as matched, so `warnUnmatched` reports it as matching nothing. Example: `swift*.md,swift-ui.md` with a file `swift-ui.md`. The exclusion itself still applies, so this is a wrong diagnostic, but the warning exists for exactly this class of silent misconfiguration. Record every matching pattern, and add an overlap case to `rulesExclude.test.ts`, which currently covers single patterns only.

findings.title: Header comment names a dependency that no longer exists
findings.description: The header says the module keeps `setup-ide, commandInstaller, and worktreePropagation` acyclic. `worktreePropagation.ts` now imports only `fs`, `path`, and core types, so the claim is stale. Drop that name from the comment.

findings.title: BEGIN marker is documented as a substring match, but the installer matches whole lines
findings.description: `ideTargets.ts` says `MANAGED_BEGIN_MARKER` is "Matched as a substring", and `setup-ide.ts`'s `lineIsManagedMarker` uses `includes`. `managedState` compares `line === MANAGED_BEGIN_MARKER`. With an indented BEGIN line, the overwrite prompt is skipped but the installer reports "unbalanced markers" and refuses to write. This predates the diff. Pick one contract and make the three sites agree.

findings.title: Error predicate in `installIde` is broader than "filesystem error"
findings.description: `isFilesystemError` returns true for any `Error` with a string `code`, not only Node fs errors. A non-filesystem error that carries a code becomes exit 1 with a message instead of propagating as a bug. Narrow it to the fs error codes, or to `syscall` plus `path`.

findings.title: Dry-run path list duplicates target knowledge
findings.description: `INSTALL_PATHS` repeats the top-level paths the targets write, and `tests/ideInstall/harness.ts` keeps a second copy. If a target starts writing somewhere else, the dry-run report will show false additions. Derive the list from the target descriptors or share one constant.

findings.title: Test hygiene in `flags.test.ts`
findings.description: Two items. `test_flags_root_outside_guide` passes `--root`, a flag the CLI no longer has. The harness works around this at `harness.ts:109`, and the snapshot label `setup-ide claude --root <TMP>` documents a flag that does not exist. Separately, the sandbox-removal test asserts over the global `os.tmpdir()` listing, which is racy if another `cf setup-ide --dry-run` runs at the same time. Remove the `--root` argument and the special case, and scope the assertion to the sandbox path the test can observe.

findings.title: Convoluted no-op in the ruff `extend-select` builder

structured_findings.summary: Stale-file pruning lost its containment guard
Dry run can write through absolute symlinks into real locations
Overlapping `rules.exclude` patterns produce a false "matched no rule files" warning
Header comment names a dependency that no longer exists
BEGIN marker is documented as a substring match, but the installer matches whole lines
Error predicate in `installIde` is broader than "filesystem error"
Dry-run path list duplicates target knowledge
Convoluted no-op in the ruff `extend-select` builder
